plain_explanation: 8 of 1091 simulated patients share an unusual combination of symptoms (Hypoplastic toenails, Global developmental delay, Gingival overgrowth). Hypoplastic toenails appears in 100% of them versus 0.7% of the whole cohort, about 136 times more than expected. To check whether this could be chance, the same clustering was run on 100 reshuffled copies of the data that keep every symptom's overall frequency and every patient's number of symptoms. Among 2200 comparable clusters found in shuffled data, clusters scoring this high were rare (p ≤ 0.000, adjusted q = 0.012), so it passes the false-discovery threshold. This is a research lead on simulated data, not a diagnosis.
